title: Concept: Redirect via res.redirect (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, res.redirect issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via a same-origin check.
applicability: javascript request handlers redirecting through res.redirect; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
